resultsProcessor.script: function call(request) { var response = context.sendToStep('accept-storage', JSON.stringify(request)); if (response.isErrored()) throw new Error(response.getAllErrors()[0]); return JSON.parse(response.getBody()); } var pair = 'local-file-pair'; var publicRecord = { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'public' }; var secretRecord = { format: 'opscotch-key-store/key-record/v2', recordType: 'secret' }; var get = { operation: 'getPair', pairId: pair, publicRecordId: 'public', secretRecordId: 'secret', includeSecret: true }; var bytes = context.bytes(); var idBytes = bytes.createFromString(pair); var digest = bytes.sha256(idBytes); var file = bytes.binaryToHex(digest) + '.pair.json'; bytes.release([idBytes, digest]); try { context.files('storage-root').delete(file); } catch (error) {} if (call(get).status !== 'not-found') throw new Error('expected missing pair'); var put = { operation: 'putPairIfAbsent', pairId: pair, publicRecordId: 'public', secretRecordId: 'secret', publicRecord: publicRecord, secretRecord: secretRecord }; if (call(put).status !== 'created') throw new Error('expected pair creation'); if (call(get).status !== 'ok') throw new Error('expected pair retrieval'); if (call(put).status !== 'conflict') throw new Error('expected pair conflict'); context.sendMetric('storage-local-file-contract-pass', 1.0);
